snippet.title: Zero Parades: Director's Cut - Nintendo Switch 2 and PS5 Reveal | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

ZA/UM's story-rich espionage RPG casts you as Hershel Wilk, codename CASCADE, a burnt-out spy who gets one last assignment to make up for a past failure.
